brand_identity.concept: Premium technology deals platform. Swiss & High-Contrast meets Editorial Future. Minimalist, technical, high-performance.

typography.strategy: No Inter. Mix premium geometric sans with tech-forward mono.

colors.strategy: Deep Zinc (Obsidian) foundation with vibrant Orange triggers. Avoid generic grays.

layouts_and_grids.spacing_scale: Luxurious. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Double the standard whitespace.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 for featured sections.

Navbar.style: Sticky top-0 z-50. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border-b border-border.
Navbar.layout: Left: Logo. Center: Categories (hidden on mobile). Right: Search, Theme, Lang, Hamburger.

HeroSection.visuals: Technical grid background (bg-grid-white/[0.02]) with top-center radial spotlight (orange-900/20).
HeroSection.content: Verified affiliate badge (pill), massive H1, stats row (font-mono), 'Explore Deals' CTA (orange).

ProductCard.container: relative flex flex-col bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 group
ProductCard.image_wrapper: relative h-48 w-full p-6 bg-zinc-900/50 flex items-center justify-center
ProductCard.badges: Absolute top-3 left-3. Discount badge: bg-primary text-white text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full
ProductCard.price_row: flex items-baseline gap-2 font-mono. Current: text-xl font-bold text-white. Old: text-sm line-through text-zinc-500
ProductCard.meta: Rating (stars), review count, Prime badge, affiliate disclosure text (text-[10px] text-zinc-500)
ProductCard.actions: Bottom row: 'View Deal' button (w-full, primary color or subtle zinc hover), Wishlist (icon), Share (icon)

CategoryRail.style: Horizontal scroll (hide scrollbar) or flex-wrap. Items: pill or squircle cards.
CategoryRail.item: flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border border-border rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/30 hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-sm font-bold

SearchBar.style: Premium elongated input. bg-zinc-900 border-border focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50.
SearchBar.dropdown: Instant suggestions panel attached below, blurred background, divided into Products, Brands, Guides.

motion.rules: No bouncy animations. Smooth, intentional, hardware-accelerated transitions only.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over orange has high contrast (use white or zinc-950).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-search-input', data-testid='product-card-view-deal').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT output generic purple/violet gradients. Stick to the Zinc + Orange palette.
DO NOT use Inter font. Configure Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, and JetBrains Mono in Next.js layout.
Implement full Hindi/English i18n support in routing (App Router).
Product images must have explicit width/height or fill with object-contain for optimal LCP.
DO NOT make backgrounds fully transparent if content sits beneath them. Use backdrop-blur + bg-background/70.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural creative layouts, but rely on Shadcn UI for complex inputs, dropdowns, and dialogs.
Add transition-all for interactive elements, but DO NOT use 'transition: all' in global CSS. Use Tailwind classes.
Build a custom 404 page that matches the premium brand look.
Use data-testid on every single button and link for automated QA.

tailwind_extensions.instructions: Merge these into your tailwind.config.js theme section.
